title: [opencv4[qt]] build failure with latest commit version 0ab1a9e

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Host Environment**
- OS: win10 1909 Build18363.815
- Compiler: VS2019 16.5.4

**To Reproduce**

`./vcpkg install opencv4[qt] --recurse`
